summary: Redirect to the requested audio file for a track
description: Returns an HTTP redirect to the audio file URL for a given track. The endpoint accepts a limited set of query parameters and does not inherit the usual parent parameters. If the track's 'audiodownload_allowed' flag is false, the request will result in a 404 error. The default action is 'download' and the default audio format is 'mp31'.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the track to retrieve. Only one track id is accepted.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, the response header includes 'results_fullcount' with the total number of rows that would be returned without limit/offset.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Desired audio format for the returned file. Defaults to mp31 if not specified.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Specifies whether the request is for streaming or downloading; helps server optimize handling.

notes: The endpoint performs an HTTP redirect; no JSON body is returned.
A 404 error is returned when 'audiodownload_allowed' (or 'track_audiodownload_allowed') is false for the requested track.
Only the parameters listed above are accepted; standard parent parameters are not inherited.
The 'client_id' parameter is mandatory for authentication; ensure it is valid.
